disclaimer: Not investment advice. target_change records what a broker filed, not a buy/sell recommendation.
priceStatus: ⬜ Not priced yet. The redistribution scope of the underlying listing has not been confirmed (see notMeasured) — this file ships free until that is resolved.
whatThisIs: One row per Hankyung Consensus broker report from consensus-2026-09-10.json (a rolling ~31-day window the source page itself enforces — this is not our archive's full history). 644 reports · 111 raised/lowered target prices · 165 named analysts · 12 brokers · 169 tickers.
whatThisIsNot: Not a live feed — this is a dated snapshot; it does not update after publication.
Not a buy/sell signal. target_change is a fact about what the broker filed, not a recommendation.
Not backfillable. The source page only ever shows ~31 days; a day not collected on time is gone for good (see check-archive-freshness.mjs, "산업활동동향" 갈래 pattern applied to this collector too).

columns.analyst_name: Named analyst as the source lists it. Null if the source did not attribute one.
columns.ticker: KRX 6-digit code. Null for macro/non-ticker reports.
columns.sector: Sector label as the source lists it (Korean). Null if not a sector-tagged report.
columns.rating: Analyst rating/opinion as filed (Korean, e.g. 매수/BUY). Not translated — we do not invent an English gloss.
columns.target_price: Target price in this report. Null, not 0, if the report did not set one — a filed "0" is treated as "not stated," never as a price.
columns.prev_target_price: The analyst's previous target for the same stock, when the source states one. Null if none.
columns.target_change: "raised" | "lowered" | "held" | "new" | null. Computed by us from target_price vs prev_target_price. Null only when this report itself carries no target price.

notMeasured: ⬜ Redistribution scope of the Hankyung Consensus listing — we recount the list ourselves (facts: report id, house, analyst, target, rating), but whether the listing itself may be redistributed as a product is not yet confirmed. Do not price this file until that is resolved.
